newsitem.title: USA: US LPG steady as industry event dulls trade.
newsitem.headline: US LPG steady as industry event dulls trade.

text.p: U.S. spot liquefied petroleum gas prices were steady in dead trade on Monday amid a heavily-attended industry event, players said.
Many players were out of their offices at a golf tournament sponsored by the electronic trading company Chalkboard.
"It's very quiet today," said a Houston-based trader.
In the U.S. Gulf Coast, Mont Belvieu, Texas, propane parcels remained at 35.00 cents to 35.25 cents. A 35.25-cent parcel was heard done.
-- Laney Salisbury, New York Energy Desk +1 212 859 1631
